translations.web: They killed the Passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood which they received of their hand, and the Levites skinned them.
translations.bsb: And they slaughtered the Passover lambs, while the priests splattered the blood handed to them and the Levites skinned the animals.
translations.kjv: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands, and the Levites flayed them.
